description: Military Airport is a dataset listed in Caltrans GIS Data hub, an open geospatial data hub of a state transportation department, published or maintained by Caltrans. This is a point layer of Military Airports currently permitted by the State of California, Department of Transportation (Caltrans), Division of Transportation Planning Aeronautics Program. The attributes include the airport location, function class, ownership, and the link of Federal Aviation Administration (FAA) site. FAA website has airport detail information and master records and reports. Coverage: California, United States. The hub lists this as a dataset of Caltrans. Its keywords are Airport, California, California Department of Transportation, California State Transportation Agency, CalSTA, Caltrans, CAOpenData, Military Airfields. The bounding box given is -122.0483,32.5662,-115.6717,40.2663. The hub shows 2024-09-05 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is a licence or disclaimer text is given on the hub listing (This public data is provided as a service for planning purposes and not intended for design, navigation purposes or airs ...); terms not read in full. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support network, hazard exposure and resilience studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-caltrans-gis-data-hub.
